tasks.short: Discuss print job requirements and binding plans.

steps.what: Retrieve actual print job ticket, approved proof and current binding specifications in native views
inputs: actual current job ticket, proof version and binding specifications

steps.what: Meet clients, printers or designers to discuss actual job requirements and binding plans
inputs: actual participant requirements and production constraints
outputs: actual discussed binding requirements and unresolved questions

steps.what: Enter actual binding requirements in the job ticket and check the complete final entry
inputs: actual discussed binding requirements and unresolved questions
outputs: checked complete final actual binding requirement entry for the exact job

steps.what: Save checked final binding requirement entry to the designated job ticket
inputs: checked complete final actual binding requirement entry for the exact job

tasks.design: Configure native print job and approved-proof links in {PRINT_MIS}. The worker still discusses actual requirements and enters actual changes directly in the job ticket. Existing entry checking covers the final-version save gate; no additional approval ceremony or report is created. Only repeated reference retrieval changes.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated retrieval of actual job and binding reference versions before discussions.
tasks.enabler_now: Native linked print job and proof records.
tasks.still_hard: Understanding actual client expectations and practical binding constraints.
tasks.human_edge: Resolving what a client means by the desired finished product.
tasks.altitude: Less job-reference retrieval around unchanged binding discussions.

evidence.claim: Print management systems hold job order forms and related records; the linked discussion reference view is proposed, not measured.

assumptions: Shares are provisional and require observed residual job-reference retrieval after native configuration. Existing view runtime earns no saving. This does not claim recurring briefing or report work beyond actual job ticket changes.

Actual order and proof owners provide job_id, proof_version and binding_spec_version. s1 retains 5 hours checking currency and scope; missing references are retrieved manually. Actual listening and job-entry capture remain fully counted in s2/s3.

s3 is existing accurate entry and checking work, not invented self-approval time. Its complete final entry and exact job cover the separate save gate. Changed entry or destination voids the gate. Same-system save retains full effort; minimum share is schema granularity, not measured click cost. No external send is proposed.
unknowns: Whether an actual job ticket change follows each meeting
research_questions: What repeated reference retrieval remains after current print job tools?

incremental.description: Maintain current job and proof reference links

approvals.approved_version: s3 checked complete final actual binding requirement entry and exact job

time_saved_range_pct.basis: 10 times 50% residual retrieval benefit = 5 less 0.5 upkeep = 4.5. Low halves retrieval benefit: 2.5 less 0.5 = 2; provisional. No added report or same-system-save benefit.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Binding workers retain actual client discussion and job-entry accuracy with less repeated reference retrieval.
reach: Clients and production specialists retain their actual choices and separate work.
role.ambitious_version: Actual binding requirements stay attached to the current job and proof without extra paperwork.
